name: Sigma splice (sigmas_concat)
plain: Replaces the tail of one schedule with the tail of another at an index. Its optional rescale multiplies by Σresult/Σσ₁, which pushes the sum further from the first schedule rather than matching it: matching would need the inverse ratio.
label: from code
surprise: The rescale factor multiplies by the ratio of sums rather than dividing by it, so a schedule whose sum grew gets larger still (sigmas_merge.py:209).

audit.note: The first draft said the rescale makes the sums match. The code multiplies by Σresult/Σσ₁, which does not.
